cross_model_reproduction.v1.label: Reproduction in another cellular model
cross_model_reproduction.v1.negative_means: A dependency that is real and context-specific is expected to fail this endpoint in the wrong context. A negative here is information about transfer, not about the original hit.
cross_model_reproduction.v1.question: cross_model

in_vivo_reproduction.v1.label: Reproduction in vivo
in_vivo_reproduction.v1.negative_means: In vivo failure can be pharmacokinetic, immunological or about the microenvironment, none of which is a statement about the in vitro measurement.
in_vivo_reproduction.v1.question: cross_model

ko_fitness_independent_guide.v1.label: Independent guide, knockout fitness
ko_fitness_independent_guide.v1.negative_means: A negative result here says this guide did not reproduce the depletion under this assay. It does not establish that the gene has no phenotype.
ko_fitness_independent_guide.v1.notes: The default genetic-reproduction endpoint for pooled knockout fitness screens. The effect bar belongs to the assay that measures it.
ko_fitness_independent_guide.v1.question: reproduces

ko_fitness_independent_guide_set.v1.label: Independent guide set, knockout fitness
ko_fitness_independent_guide_set.v1.negative_means: A negative result here is stronger than one independent guide failing, because two or more perturbations of the same target agreed on not reproducing it.
ko_fitness_independent_guide_set.v1.question: reproduces

organoid_growth_arrayed.v1.label: Arrayed organoid growth
organoid_growth_arrayed.v1.negative_means: A negative result here is about this organoid model. It does not transfer to the 2D line the screen was run in, or to another donor's organoid.
organoid_growth_arrayed.v1.notes: Modelled on the arrayed individual-gRNA growth assay in doi:10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-24-0775, where CDK2, PTK2 and PRKDC gRNAs reduced organoid area in ICSBCS002 and reduced it for only some guides in ICSBCS007. The 50%/p<0.05 figures in that paper are the screen's own hit criterion, which is why they are carried here as an example and not as this endpoint's default bar.

published_example.screen_hit_criterion: a reduction of at least 50% (log2 fold change < -1) and a p value < 0.05
published_example.what: Kinome-focused CRISPR-Cas9 screens in African-ancestry patient-derived breast cancer organoids

organoid_growth_arrayed.v1.question: cross_model

orthogonal_crispri.v1.label: CRISPRi knockdown of the same target
orthogonal_crispri.v1.negative_means: CRISPRi reduces transcript rather than cutting DNA. A disagreement with knockout can mean the knockout phenotype was a cutting artefact, or that partial knockdown was not enough. It does not by itself decide which.
orthogonal_crispri.v1.question: target_specific

orthogonal_genetic_other.v1.label: Other orthogonal genetic assay
orthogonal_genetic_other.v1.negative_means: The direction is not prespecified for this catch-all endpoint, so it is the weakest of the orthogonal endpoints and is reported separately from CRISPRi and rescue.
orthogonal_genetic_other.v1.notes: A named endpoint is always preferable. This exists so an unusual assay can be recorded with its criteria rather than dropped.
orthogonal_genetic_other.v1.question: target_specific

pharmacologic_inhibition.v1.label: Selective small-molecule inhibition
pharmacologic_inhibition.v1.negative_means: This is the endpoint most often misread. A compound that does not recapitulate a genetic phenotype may be a poor compound, dosed below its effective range, or aimed at a target that partial inhibition does not touch the way a knockout does. It is not evidence that the screen hit was false. In doi:10.1158/0008-5472.CAN-24-0775 the PRKDC inhibitors LTURM34 and AZD7648 showed no potent activity at the tested concentrations while the individual gRNAs did reduce growth, and of two PTK2 inhibitors one had no effect on either line while the other produced a partial response in one.
pharmacologic_inhibition.v1.notes: Records the compound and concentration in the measurement, because a pharmacologic outcome without them cannot be interpreted or reused.

published_example.screen_hit_criterion: a reduction of at least 50% (log2 fold change < -1) and a p value < 0.05
published_example.what: Kinome-focused CRISPR-Cas9 screens in African-ancestry patient-derived breast cancer organoids

pharmacologic_inhibition.v1.question: pharmacologic

rescue_complementation.v1.label: Rescue by complementation
rescue_complementation.v1.negative_means: A rescue that does not restore the phenotype can mean the phenotype was off-target, or that the construct was not expressed or not functional.
rescue_complementation.v1.notes: The direction is reversed on purpose: a rescue validates by restoring growth, so the prespecified effect is enriched.
rescue_complementation.v1.question: target_specific

question_label.cross_model: Reproduction in another model or context
question_label.pharmacologic: Pharmacologic recapitulation with a selective compound
question_label.reproduces: Independent genetic reproduction in the same model
question_label.target_specific: Target specificity under an orthogonal perturbation

question_sentence.cross_model: estimated probability of reproducing the phenotype in another model or biological context
question_sentence.pharmacologic: estimated probability of recapitulating the phenotype pharmacologically with a selective inhibitor
question_sentence.reproduces: estimated probability of reproducing the phenotype with an independent perturbation in the same model
question_sentence.target_specific: estimated probability that the effect survives an orthogonal perturbation of the same target
